extracted.name: Simple Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts
extracted.description: Air fryer Brussels sprouts simply seasoned with olive oil and garlic come out crispy on the outsides, tender on the insides, and delicious all the way through.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 15 minutes according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Meanwhile, trim Brussels sprouts. Place in a bowl. Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; toss well.
Spread sprouts evenly in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 15 minutes, checking and shaking the basket halfway through the cycle.
